scripts.aws:build:lambda: npm run build && sam build --template template-lambda.yaml
scripts.aws:deploy:lambda: npm run build && sam build --template template-lambda.yaml && sam deploy --config-file samconfig-lambda.toml --guided
scripts.aws:deploy:s3: sam build --template template-s3.yaml && sam deploy --config-file samconfig-s3.toml --guided
scripts.aws:infra:lambda:simple: npm run build && sam build --template template-lambda.yaml && sam deploy --guided --template template-lambda.yaml --s3-bucket sam-cli-deployments-us-east-1
scripts.aws:infra:lambda:direct: npm run build && sam build --template template-lambda.yaml && sam deploy --config-file samconfig-lambda.toml --parameter-overrides MongoUri=${MONGO_URI}
